q: OLD QUEENE. O no, sweet Margaret, the fatall poyson Doth work within my heart, my brain pan breakes, My heart doth faint, I dye.

e: Borrowed from Russian Поя́рков (Pojárkov) + -ite. Named in honor of Vladimir Erastovich Poyarkov (1907‒1975).

q:
Which over Severne heere they in the Mountaines shut,
And some upon that poynt of Cornwall forth they put.

e: From Old French poi (“small hill”), from Latin podium.
